embeds.description:
"Lightning" is off of Mitski's album "Nothing's About To Happen To Me"

Lyrics
Lightning hit so close
Sounded like a big tin can
All hail the rain
All hail the rain
Running like ghosts on the roof
Running like they're feeling alive again

"Here we are
We've been waiting
To be born again"

When I die
